scripts.build: pnpm --filter @smartkids/web run build && pnpm --filter @smartkids/api run build
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter @smartkids/web run build && pnpm --filter @smartkids/api exec wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm --filter @smartkids/web run build && pnpm --filter @smartkids/api exec wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm --filter @smartkids/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply smartkids --remote
scripts.db:migrate:staging: pnpm --filter @smartkids/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply smartkids_staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:seed:staging: pnpm --filter @smartkids/api exec wrangler d1 execute smartkids_staging --remote --env staging --file=seed.sql
